mutant.lineText: if (s.kind === 'transform' && s.rowsIn !== s.kept + s.dropped + s.failed) out.push(`${s.name} took in ${plural(s.rowsIn, 'row')} but kept ${s.kept}, dropped ${s.dropped} and failed ${s.failed}.`);
mutant.prevText: if (prev && s.rowsIn !== prev.rowsOut) out.push(`${prev.name} put out ${plural(prev.rowsOut, 'row')} but ${s.name} took in ${plural(s.rowsIn, 'row')}.`);
mutant.nextText: if (s.kind === 'load' && s.rowsIn !== s.inserted + s.updated + s.unchanged + s.superseded + s.failed) out.push(`load took in ${plural(s.rowsIn, 'row')} but inserted ${s.inserted}, updated ${s.updated}, left ${s.unchanged} unchanged, superseded ${s.superseded} and failed ${s.failed}.`);
